successors.name: Kakatiya dynasty
successors.text: Chakrakota mandala, covering present-day Bastar, Koraput and Kalahandi districts

ledger.x: c. 1023: the Chindaka Nagas found Chakrakota mandala (some historians say they came with Rajendra Chola's expedition c. 1022).
c. 1324: last known ruler Harishchandradeva (Sati inscription); Kakatiya pressure in Bastar from Ganapatideva in the 13th century.
c. 1324: end of the Chindaka Naga dynasty.

certainty.note: Districts named, no boundaries; Kakatiya succession in 1324 is a bridge.
